title: Kubernetes OOMKilled Pod Crash Exit Code 137
summary: Container exceeding configured memory limits causing Linux kernel cgroup OOM killer to terminate the process with SIGKILL.
root_cause: Container memory limit is lower than JVM heap or application memory leaks under peak load.
remediation: Increase resources.limits.memory in the deployment manifest and inspect heap dumps for memory leaks.

title: PostgreSQL Connection Pool Starvation and Max Connections Reached
summary: Backend microservices receiving FATAL remaining connection slots are reserved for non-replication superuser connections.
root_cause: Unclosed database connections in application thread pools or lack of connection pooling proxy (PgBouncer).
remediation: Deploy PgBouncer in transaction mode and tune max_connections and idle connection timeouts in postgresql.conf.

title: Elasticsearch Unassigned Shards and Disk Flood Stage Watermark
summary: Elasticsearch cluster state turns RED due to unassigned primary shards caused by disk usage exceeding 95 percent flood stage.
root_cause: Disk utilization passed cluster.routing.allocation.disk.watermark.flood_stage locking indices into read_only_allow_delete.
remediation: Free disk space or add storage, then clear read-only block using index.blocks.read_only_allow_delete: null.

title: CoreDNS Query Timeout and Resolution Failure in Pods
summary: Applications encountering intermittent dial tcp lookup i/o timeout when resolving internal or external service hostnames.
root_cause: CoreDNS upstream saturation or default ndots:5 causing excessive search domain suffix lookup queries.
remediation: Configure NodeLocal DNSCache DaemonSet and optimize pod dnsConfig ndots setting.

title: TLS SSL Certificate Expiration and Handshake Failure
summary: External clients and ingress gateways reporting certificate expired x509 err and aborting TLS handshakes.
root_cause: Automated cert-manager ACME Let's Encrypt renewal failed due to DNS challenge webhook failure.
remediation: Renew certificate via manual secret update, fix cert-manager Issuer credentials, and set up Prometheus alert at 30 days before expiry.

title: Kafka Consumer Group Lag Rebalancing Storm
summary: Kafka consumers in consumer group repeatedly disconnecting and triggering stop-the-world partition rebalances.
root_cause: Single message processing time exceeds max.poll.interval.ms causing coordinator to assume consumer is dead.
remediation: Increase max.poll.interval.ms or decrease max.poll.records to ensure poll loop is called within timeout.

title: Redis Memory Fragmentation Ratio Spike and Latency
summary: Redis memory fragmentation ratio exceeds 2.5 causing high OS swap activity and command latency spikes.
root_cause: Frequent allocation and deallocation of varied size keys with jemalloc memory allocator fragmentation.
remediation: Enable activedefrag yes in redis.conf or restart replica node and failover cleanly.

title: Linux Kernel File Descriptor Exhaustion Too Many Open Files
summary: High-throughput web servers logging socket accept error: too many open files in system.
root_cause: Process nofile ulimit setting is default 1024 or fs.file-max kernel limit is saturated.
remediation: Increase ulimit -n 65535 in systemd service unit and tune fs.file-max in /etc/sysctl.conf.

title: Elasticsearch High JVM Garbage Collection Stop-The-World Pauses
summary: Elasticsearch nodes dropping out of cluster intermittently with master not discovered or ping timeout.
root_cause: Expensive wildcard queries or massive bucket aggregations triggering JVM G1GC old generation pauses exceeding 15 seconds.
remediation: Tune max JVM heap to 50 percent of RAM (max 31GB for compressed oops) and enable search slow logs to kill heavy aggregations.

title: AWS S3 503 SlowDown Rate Limit and Request Throttling
summary: Applications encountering HTTP 503 SlowDown errors when uploading or downloading objects at high concurrency.
root_cause: Exceeding Amazon S3 prefix request rate limits (3500 PUT/POST/DELETE or 5500 GET requests per second per prefix).
remediation: Partition S3 object keys across multiple hash prefixes and implement exponential backoff with jitter in SDK client.

title: Nginx Ingress 502 Bad Gateway Upstream Connection Refused
summary: Ingress controller returning HTTP 502 Bad Gateway to incoming internet web users.
root_cause: Target backend pod terminated or readinessProbe failed while ingress endpoint controller still routes traffic to it.
remediation: Configure preStop sleep hook (sleep 5) in pod container lifecycle to allow ingress routing table propagation before shutdown.

title: ArgoCD Application OutOfSync and GitOps Sync Failure
summary: ArgoCD continuous delivery controller dashboard marks application OutOfSync and automated sync fails.
root_cause: Immutable field modification attempt (e.g., StatefulSet spec.volumeClaimTemplates) or mutating webhook drift.
remediation: Review git commit diff, add ignoreDifferences for mutating fields or delete and re-create resource with proper cascade flags.

title: MySQL Deadlock Encountered When Trying To Get Lock
summary: Application database layer throws Deadlock found when trying to get lock; try restarting transaction.
root_cause: Concurrent transactions updating multiple tables or rows in differing non-deterministic order with Row-Level locks.
remediation: Ensure all application transactions acquire locks in identical sequential order and implement retry logic with exponential backoff.

title: BGP Route Flapping and Intermittent Packet Loss
summary: Border gateway routers continuously advertising and withdrawing network prefixes causing latency and packet drops.
root_cause: Flapping physical link or hold timer expiration between autonomous system peer routers.
remediation: Enable BGP route flap dampening, replace faulty optical transceiver or SFP module, and adjust keepalive timers.

title: Prometheus Scrape Interval Timeout and TSDB Compaction Failure
summary: Prometheus server reporting context deadline exceeded when scraping endpoints and TSDB WAL corruption.
root_cause: High cardinality metric labels (e.g. user_id or IP in label names) causing time series database block compaction OOM.
remediation: Drop high cardinality labels via metric_relabel_configs and increase Prometheus TSDB block retention limits.

title: Kubernetes CrashLoopBackOff Pod Restarting Infinitely
summary: Pod fails immediately upon startup and enters an exponential backoff restart delay cycle.
root_cause: Missing environment variable, invalid configuration file path, or database dependency unavailable during application boot.
remediation: Check kubectl logs --previous <pod> and describe pod to identify startup exception and missing ConfigMap keys.

title: Elasticsearch Mapping Explosion Out of Memory
summary: Cluster state size grows rapidly to hundreds of megabytes causing master node timeouts and memory exhaustion.
root_cause: Dynamic mapping enabled on an index receiving unstructured JSON objects with arbitrary dynamic keys (e.g. UUID keys).
remediation: Use flattened field type for dynamic user-defined payloads or enforce dynamic: strict on root index mapping.

title: Spring Boot JVM Heap OutOfMemoryError Java Heap Space
summary: Spring Boot microservice throwing java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space and failing health checks.
root_cause: Large unpaged SQL result sets loaded into memory or static collection memory leak retaining object references.
remediation: Enforce pagination (LIMIT / OFFSET or keyset) on repository queries and capture heap dump with -XX:+HeapDumpOnOutOfMemoryError.

title: Docker Daemon Socket Permission Denied Dial Unix
summary: CI/CD pipeline jobs failing with Got permission denied while trying to connect to the Docker daemon socket.
root_cause: Pipeline runner user is not a member of the docker group on the host machine.
remediation: Run sudo usermod -aG docker <runner-user> and reload group permissions or restart runner service.

title: Elasticsearch CircuitBreakerException Parent Data Too Large
summary: Elasticsearch search and index queries failing with [parent] Data too large, data for [<transport_request>] would be larger than limit.
root_cause: Cluster-wide memory consumption exceeded indices.breaker.total.use_real_memory threshold (default 95% of heap).
remediation: Reduce aggregation query concurrency, optimize shard sizes to 10-50GB, and clear cache via POST /_cache/clear.
